content.title: How to get tickets for the 2027 Masters at Augusta National
content.text: Here's how to get tickets for the 2027 Masters at Augusta National Golf Club in Augusta, Ga. Getty Images AUGUSTA, Ga. — Apologies, but if you are reading this, you are probably not at this week’s 90th Masters at Augusta National Golf Club.But don’t fret, because like the 91 players in the field this week, you need to be optimistic, too. There’s still a chance for you to get tickets for next year. Here’s how you can do that.How to get 2027 Masters ticketsYour first step to get tickets for the 2027 Masters is to enter the Masters ticket lottery, which is your best way to find yourself at Augusta National come this time next year.The application window is not open at this time, but here’s what you need to do so you are prepared. (You can also go to the Masters site and it will help you set a calendar invite so you remember to apply.)When it’s time to apply — the window goes live June 1-20, 2026 — go to the Masters site here and either log in to your existing account or create a new one. Select which days you want to attend and how many tickets (1-4). You can select all the days if you like (Monday through Sunday) although if you win it will only be for one day, and you won’t get to decide which.For those who win the lottery, you’ll be notified and need to supply payment in July.Ticket prices for next year have not yet been announced, but for the 2026 Masters it was $125 for Monday and Tuesday, $150 for Wednesday and $160 for tournament rounds on Thursday to Sunday. The tournament-round price was a $20 increase from 2025.This is your best chance to get Masters tickets — unless you somehow stumble into a coveted Masters badge — because doing so from third-party sites could potentially lead to your tickets being canceled and you banned from future tournaments.
